name: Romanian deadlift
summary: Hinge at the hips and lower a bar along your legs with a flat back and soft knees. Trains the hamstrings and glutes through a long stretch.
setup: Stand with your feet hip width apart, the bar over the middle of your feet. Start from a rack or deadlift it from the floor.
Hold the bar just outside your thighs, palms facing you, arms straight.
Bend your knees slightly, about 15 to 20 degrees, and keep that bend for the whole rep.

steps.text: Breathe in, brace your trunk, and pull your shoulders back and down so your armpits feel tight.
Push your hips straight back as if closing a car door with your backside. Your torso tips forward as a unit and the bar slides down your thighs.
Stop when you feel a strong stretch in the back of your thighs, or just before your back starts to round. For most people this is around mid-shin.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall. Squeeze your glutes at the top without leaning back. Breathe out at the top.

jointCues.cue: Back, not down. The movement is a hinge, not a squat.
jointCues.why: Moving the hips back lengthens the hamstrings, which is the point of the lift.

jointCues.cue: Flat from tailbone to head. Keep the chin tucked a little, eyes on the floor a metre or two ahead.
jointCues.why: A neutral spine lets the hips do the work and keeps the discs out of a loaded, rounded position.

jointCues.cue: Shoulders back and down. Push the bar into your legs as if hiding your armpits.
jointCues.why: Tight lats keep the bar against your body and stop the upper back from rounding.

jointCues.cue: Soft and fixed. Shins stay nearly vertical.
jointCues.why: If the knees bend more as you go down, it turns into a squat and takes the stretch off the hamstrings.

jointCues.cue: Straight up and down over mid-foot, touching your legs.
jointCues.why: A bar that drifts forward multiplies the load on your lower back.

breathing: Breathe in and brace at the top before each rep. Hold it on the way down and up. Breathe out at the top.

mistakes.fix: Stop higher. Range comes from the hips, not the spine.

mistakes.fault: Bar drifts away from the legs
mistakes.fix: Pull the bar back into your thighs with your lats.

mistakes.fault: Knees keep bending as you go down
mistakes.fix: Set the knee bend at the start, then only move the hips.
Finish with glutes tight and ribs stacked over the pelvis.

safety: If you feel it in your lower back instead of your hamstrings, lighten the load and shorten the range.

cues.text: Bar slides straight down your legs over mid-foot
Push your hips back, like closing a door behind you
Flat back from tailbone to head
Shoulders back and down, armpits tight
Soft knees, shins stay nearly vertical
Drive the hips forward and squeeze the glutes
